amp.notes: Keep the early sections spacious and restrained; build gradually into the later choruses.

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.content:
We'll do it all
Everything
On our own
We don't need
Anything
Or anyone

sections.name: Chorus 1
sections.content:
If I lay here
If I just lay here
Would you lie with me and just forget the world?

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.content:
I don't quite know
How to say
How I feel
Those three words
Are said too much
They're not enough

sections.name: Chorus 2
sections.content:
If I lay here
If I just lay here
Would you lie with me and just forget the world?
Forget what we're told
Before we get too old
Show me a garden that's burstin' into life

sections.name: Verse 3
sections.content:
Let's waste time
Chasin' cars
Around our heads
I need your grace
To remind me
To find my own

sections.name: Chorus 3
sections.content:
If I lay here
If I just lay here
Would you lie with me and just forget the world?
Forget what we're told
Before we get too old
Show me a garden that's burstin' into life
All that I am
All that I ever was
Is here in your perfect eyes, they're all I can see
I don't know where
Confused about how, as well
Just know that these things will never change for us at all

sections.name: Outro
sections.content:
If I lay here
If I just lay here
Would you lie with me and just forget the world?
